text: D1 maps a non-frame-bound PD representative across an edge. Its entry also stands for a physical same-table write, so promoting it through its rep (to kt, or kt under an nt key) hides a physical obligation. The derived fold reads the rep's state.

text: PdFrames (a parameter-index set per member) is not L4-equivalent. It discards the kt branch of a temp+real mix (X.Insert;Y.Insert with temp X, real Y), and it confuses 'no PD in this frame' with 'non-substitutable nt contributor' (A calls B with temp in a cycle: L4 has only kt at A).

file: spec D3 Carriers/Depth 0/Path = prefix x proof; src/engine/l5/digest.rs
text: Type-(ii) carriers below the root are checked in the wrong frame. A bound state's class (for example PermUi's seed PD(0), nt) holds only in its own routine, so a BFS prefix plus a zero-length proof gives PermMix -> PermUi -> producer as an nt witness, though that execution inserts into Temp. fact_equivalent ignores temp indices.

Rev 4 D3: arena states are carriers ONLY at depth 0 (the root's own non-seed states). The seed is never a carrier, and below-root arena carriers do not exist. This is sound because the transitive solve gives every root its own states for every producer it reaches (D1.2), so each root proof is valid in the root's frame by construction. PermMix in A2e now asserts EVERY nt path enters PermUi twice and no one-hop nt path exists; mutation 'admit arena states below the root as carriers' -> named red (ForwardMix). Same as R3-F02.

file: spec D3 Enumeration / Enumeration blow-up; src/engine/l5/digest.rs
text: Setting `incomplete` does nothing for consumers. Digest accumulates only `truncated`, so conditionality and ordering treat a partial path set (a short conditional proof found, a long unconditional proof cut at MAX_DEPTH) as complete.

New generated fixture IncRoot (a short conditional proof plus a 67-deep forwarding proof) in A2g; mutation 'drop the OR' -> named red 'IncRoot: conditionality conditional'.

file: spec D3 Depth 0 / Path = prefix x proof; src/engine/l5/digest.rs
text: The spec does not say whether R is expanded after its depth-0 proofs. If depth 0 is terminal, R's ordinary carriers below it are lost; if not, and below-root arena carriers remain, paths come out twice.

(2) Path identity is the edge sequence plus the terminal evidence kind and id, and an equal projected merge keeps the least restrictive conditionality (see R4-A02).

file: spec D3 'Ordinary carriers, through the BFS', A2e; src/engine/l5/digest.rs
text: The BFS is first-hop-filtered to the selected rep's witness_callsite_id, so expanding the root 'as today' does not reach other root branches. MixedCarrier can lose its second path, and ForwardMix's mutation cannot reach ForwardUi. The replacement for the first-edge filter, including guard exclusions, must be stated.
evidence: Verified at digest.rs:930-956 (the first_edges filter by witness_callsite_id). Rev 5 keeps the filter and states it as the contract (D3 'First-hop contract'; Goal 2 reworded: paths through the selected first hop, today's contract, not widened). Guards stay as the cone decided them (guarded/unguarded copies; contradicted edges never produce f). Proofs are restricted to the same first hop. MixedCarrier and ForwardMix are restructured below one root first hop, with explicit preconditions. IncRoot is also moved under one first hop (IncWrap) so its depth-limited proof is reachable.

text: Deduplicating proofs by edge sequence alone collapses distinct terminal operations (HelperTwo: a conditional p1 and an unconditional p2 behind one call edge), and merge_normalize keeps the first conditionality for equal projected paths, so an unconditional terminal can be lost.
evidence: Verified: compute_path_conditionality reads the terminal op's own context (digest.rs:2427-2464). Rev 5 D3 'Path identity and merge': raw path identity = edge sequence + terminal evidence kind and id, with tie order length, then edge sort keys, then terminal id. merge_normalize_via_paths keeps the LEAST RESTRICTIVE conditionality on an equal projected merge (the same rank effect_conditionality uses). HelperTwoTemp fixture in A2d (unconditional-on-success), with two mutations (edge-only dedup; first-wins merge), each -> named red 'HelperTwoTemp: conditionality conditional'.

text: terminal-not-found is a third source of `incomplete`. Under rev 4 the BFS for a PD-origin fact finds no ordinary carrier, so it would flag every PD-origin effect as incomplete and truncated, and conditional-only effects would become unknown. Decide it over the combined set, and decide whether it is folded.
evidence: Verified at digest.rs:1312-1316. Rev 5 D3 'Not folded: empty path sets': terminal-not-found and first-hop-not-found are decided over the COMBINED set (proofs plus BFS); the BFS reports 'no ordinary path' and the caller emits the diagnostic only when the proofs are empty too. Neither is folded into had_truncation (an empty set already gives unknown); only the state and depth limits are folded, stated in the FP-shapes bullet. CondOnlyTemp fixture in A2d (conditional, viaPathsTruncated false); mutation 'fold the BFS's own terminal-not-found into had_truncation' -> named red 'CondOnlyTemp: conditionality unknown'.

text: The budget's denominator ('the cone's bytes') is undefined because cones are freed during the walk. resolved_by_routine is missing from the numerator, and wall time has no bound.
evidence: Rev 5 D1.4: numerator = solve bytes = arena + resolved_by_routine including reps (shared per (producer, t)). Budget: solve bytes ≤ 5% of B0's measured peak RSS of the same run; peak RSS within B0's noise band; wall time ≤ B0 median + 10%. Measured on DO and CDO, release-fast, 3 runs each, for analyze and the digest probe.

file: spec D3 'Path identity and merge', acceptance A2d; src/engine/l5/digest.rs
text: The least-restrictive conditionality fix lives only in merge_normalize_via_paths, which runs in the MERGE branch and at the identity-duplicate site. An effect's first fact goes through the INSERT branch, which stores the raw projected paths and conds with no projected dedup and caps by projected_paths.len() > MAX_PATHS. So the A2d 'keep first conditionality' mutation can never turn HelperTwoTemp red (one cone fact, insert only), and projected twins (common for PD-origin facts) appear as duplicate viaPaths and count toward MAX_PATHS/had_truncation.
evidence: Verified: the insert branch (digest.rs:2979-3010) sets via = projected_paths.take(MAX_PATHS), had_truncation = outcome.truncated || projected_paths.len() > MAX_PATHS, all_paths = projected_paths, all_path_conds = path_conds, with no dedup. Rev 5b D3 'Path identity and merge': the insert branch now calls merge_normalize_via_paths(&[], &[], false, &projected_paths, &path_conds, outcome.truncated, MAX_PATHS), so both branches share one dedup-and-cap with the least-restrictive rule; viaPaths-count/truncation moves in r4f/cli-b are triaged as this cause. A2d: HelperTwoTemp has exactly ONE viaPath; the 'keep first conditionality' mutation now reds through the insert normalization ('HelperTwoTemp: conditionality conditional'); a new mutation 'skip the insert-branch normalization' -> 'HelperTwoTemp: expected 1 viaPath, got 2'. Also flash's R1-A09 note: the ForwardMix named assertion now compares the whole nt path list ('ForwardMix: nt viaPaths != [ForwardMix->Both->RealWriter]'), so it is red whatever path the mutation produces (the terminal continue at digest.rs:1215). Spec diff: .agent/runs/20261014-220818-bd516e/spec-r5-to-r5b.diff.
